The frozen REJECTED outcome (C5 FAIL, C7 FAIL) constitutes a clean scientific falsification — audit identifies V3 selection bias and ETag leakage as measurement defects contaminating the REJECTED verdict.

The pooled |r|=-0.126 represents genuine behavioral-structural coupling — audit shows this is inflated by V3 selection bias (valid cache-enabled non-304 composition skewed 91% session_status); correct stratified pooled r ~0.04.
The B-FLASK-ONLY result (r=0.026) transfers to production-like infrastructure — B-FLASK-ONLY lacks CDN simulation, OAuth middleware, and dynamic content.
Delta=0.10 is achievable at n=480 — CI width ~0.178 exceeds 2*delta=0.10; minimum detectable |r| ~0.09 at n=480.

Production-like infrastructure features (CDN/OAuth/dynamic content) break orthogonality — untested due to measurement confounds; B-FLASK-ONLY baseline (no infrastructure, r=0.026) suggests infrastructure is NOT the causal factor.
Testbed CDN simulation represents production CDN behavior — single-node Flask in-memory cache, not multi-CDN with real cache hierarchies.

The C7 negative control failure (|r|=0.12 < 0.15) means V1 entropy confound was not genuine — it may reflect weak effect under header-only extraction or endpoint heterogeneity, requiring larger n or stronger bifurcation to confirm.

recommended_action: Re-run orthogonality on the existing production-like testbed with THREE targeted corrections: (1) Fix V3 selection bias — apply non-304 filter to per-cache and per-endpoint correlations (not just pooled), and use endpoint-stratified or balanced weighting for pooled estimate. Audit shows valid cache-enabled non-304 is 91% session_status (40/44), inflating pooled r. (2) Fix V_ETAG_PERMISSION_LEAKAGE — in testbed_server.py _make_unauthorized_response(), derive permission_level from the session/endpoint context independent of token expiry (pass permission_level explicitly or derive from session before expiry check), so write-permission expired requests get write-etag not read-etag. (3) Increase n to >=800 per condition for C5/C7 power (audit shows minimum detectable |r| ~0.09 at n=480, but C5/C7 need higher power for heterogeneity/negative-control thresholds). The audit recomputed correct non-304 per-endpoint r as 0.009/0.122/-0.013 (near-zero), suggesting within-endpoint orthogonality is strong once selection bias is corrected. B-FLASK-ONLY baseline (r=0.0263) remains a strong positive prior. A clean CONFIRMED (all C1-C7 pass) would justify parallel-channel architecture for product deployment. A clean REJECTED (any C1-C7 fails after fixes) would force architectural pivot.
